issue.title: Meeting relation labels: notes from ⇄ notes in inverse display pair and a prep for label
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Polish the meeting-notes relation vocabulary.

1. Add the display-only inverse pair `notes from` ⇄ `notes in` to the named inverse phrases (docs/task-relations.md "Inverse phrases" table and its bob-cli and bob-plugins implementations). An Event Task's LINKED FROM line would then read `notes in` instead of the `(chip) · notes from → this` fallback.
2. Support a `prep for` relation label so a prep document or task can be related to the meeting it prepares for.

Source: the "Deferred" section of plan:202611/meeting_notes_event_refs.md (epic bob-cli-pw).
